map.本页用本地打包的 ISO/IEC 18004 编码器（含 Reed-Solomo: This page renders a real matrix with a local ISO/IEC 18004 encoder (including Reed-Solomon error correction), not a decorative pattern: the matrix contains finder patterns, timing patterns, format information and a mask, and phone cameras can decode it directly. The result area also shows the UTF-8 byte count, the chosen error-correction level and the minimum version (with module size), so you can judge the print size. Practical points: prefer a short link — the longer the URL, the higher the version and module density, requiring larger print size and higher scan precision; level M balances capacity and robustness, use Q/H for wear-prone materials; without an http/https protocol the scanner treats it as plain text and cannot redirect; leave a quiet zone of at least 4 modules around the printed code.

map.生成的是真二维码还是示意图？: Is this a real QR code or a decorative pattern?
map.真二维码。矩阵由本地 ISO/IEC 18004 编码器计算，包含 Reed-S: A real QR code. The matrix is computed by a local ISO/IEC 18004 encoder with Reed-Solomon codewords, format information and a mask; the page makes no network requests and uploads no URL, and you can verify it with a phone camera.
map.纠错等级选哪个？: Which error-correction level should I choose?
map.M（约 15%）最常用；打印尺寸小或物料易磨损时选 Q/H，代价是同样内容需要更: M (~15%) is the most common choice; pick Q/H when the print is small or the material wears easily, at the cost of a higher version and denser modules for the same content. L has the largest capacity but the weakest error correction, suitable for on-screen display.
map.长链接用短链更好吗？: Is a short link better for long URLs?
map.是。链接越长字节数越大，版本与模块数随之上升，小尺寸打印时更难扫。可在保持最终落: Yes. Longer links mean more bytes, a higher version and more modules, which are harder to scan when printed small. Use a short link while keeping the final landing page unchanged.
map.为什么扫出来提示不安全？: Why does scanning warn it's unsafe?
map.多半是链接用了 http 而非 https：浏览器会拦截或标记，用户也可能因警告: Mostly the link uses http rather than https: the browser blocks or flags it, and users may give up out of warning. Also if any hop in the short-link chain is http, the same warning triggers. Before publishing, confirm the entire redirect chain is HTTPS end-to-end and scan-verify the final landing page.
